item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
Kazhy is free now, all of it. No subscription, no account, no trial, no daily word limit.

Cloud transcription and AI Styles run on a Groq API key you create yourself and paste into Settings. It costs nothing on Groq’s free tier, and the ceiling there is two hours of audio in any hour, which ordinary dictation never reaches.

If you had Premium, the cloud you were paying for has been shut down, and this is what replaces it: the same models, faster, on your own account instead of ours. Your audio goes from your Mac straight to Groq, through nothing of ours.

Skip the key and nothing breaks. Transcription stays on your Mac the way it always did, and your history, vocabulary and replacements are untouched.

One thing worth saying plainly, because the setup screen that says it only appears on a fresh install: while Kazhy runs it sends a few small anonymous messages a day. They carry a random identifier for this installation, the app version, your interface language, and how many dictations you made. Nothing you said, ever. You can turn them off in Settings.

item.title: Version 1.3.4
item.description:
• The ORIGINAL half of a history card now shows what you actually said, with everything an AI Style removed struck through.
  • A replacement you add reaches re-style and retry too; one you delete stops rewriting old dictations.
  • The card shown when your free week ends quotes your own words, not your replacement list.

item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description:
• The orb is smaller and much quieter at rest; while you dictate, a ring around it answers your voice.
  • Nothing swaps in the orb's middle any more — no level bars while recording, no glyph flashing during styling.
  • Tooltips, the status pill and the picker lists now share one look.
  • ⌘⇧Y opens the style picker from anywhere.
  • Add a replacement rule, not just a word, from the “+” card.
  • Dictate into the middle of a sentence without breaking it apart.
  • The first syllable is no longer clipped, and the first dictation after a pause no longer waits on a stale token.
  • Polish resolves a spoken self-correction; styles stopped inserting em dashes; a dropped connection no longer signs you out.
